title: Call courage what happens after ego kneels
summary: This meets the self that still mistakes dominance for strength. The line says courage begins where ego kneels, not where it swells.
takeaway: Count courage by what ego can surrender.
lifeApplication: Before proving strength again, lower your voice, yield one inch, and let that be the braver act.

source.shortMeaning: Courage begins where ego kneels instead of swelling.
source.lifeApplication: Before proving strength, choose the act that lowers ego instead.

evidence.coreClaim: Courage begins where ego kneels instead of swelling.
evidence.turn: Measure courage by how deeply ego is subdued.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before proving strength again, lower your voice, yield one inch, and let that be the braver act.
